definition.description: The concentration of sodium ions in the patient's blood serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for serum sodium (commonly abbreviated as 'Na') from the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or a basic electrolyte panel in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if serum sodium is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: serum_sodium

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's biological sex from the pretreatment medical record, typically found in the patient demographics, header, or pathology report patient information section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if not documented or ambiguous.
definition.name: sex

definition.description: Presence of a skeletal compression fracture.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether a skeletal compression fracture is explicitly documented in the pretreatment clinical or imaging records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represented as Absent if no mention of a skeletal compression fracture is found in the record.
definition.name: skeletal_compression_fracture

definition.description: Presence of lytic or sclerotic lesions at the skull base.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the imaging report explicitly states the presence or absence of lytic or sclerotic lesions in the skull base or calvarium.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the skull base is not mentioned or if there is no statement regarding lytic or sclerotic lesions.
definition.name: skull_base_lytic_sclerotic_lesions

definition.description: The date the patient stopped smoking.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the date on which the patient ceased tobacco use as documented in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the date is not documented or if the patient is currently smoking.
definition.name: smoking_abstinence_date

definition.description: The length of time since the patient stopped smoking.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the duration since the patient ceased smoking, categorized as <= 5 years, 5-10 years, or > 10 years, as documented in the pretreatment records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if smoking cessation duration is not documented or the patient is a current smoker.
definition.name: smoking_cessation_duration

definition.description: The patient's lifetime tobacco use status.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's smoking status from the social history, past medical history, or review of systems. Identify whether the patient has never used tobacco, used tobacco in the past but has since quit, or is currently using tobacco.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if the documentation is absent, ambiguous, or contradictory without a clear timeline.
definition.name: smoking_status

definition.description: The mutation status of the STK11 gene, specifically whether a pathogenic alteration or loss of function is present.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the STK11 genomic status from molecular pathology or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. Any report of a pathogenic mutation, 'loss', 'loss-of-function', or 'homozygous deletion' is mapped to 'Mutated'. Reports of 'wild-type' or 'no pathogenic variants detected' are mapped to 'Wild-type'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if STK11 status is not documented or explicitly listed as unknown.
definition.name: stk11_mutation_status

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of subdural hemorrhage from pretreatment imaging reports or clinical documentation. Mark as 'present' if a subdural hemorrhage or subdural hematoma is identified; mark as 'absent' if the report explicitly states no subdural hemorrhage is present.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the records do not mention the presence or absence of subdural hemorrhage.
definition.name: subdural_hemorrhage

definition.description: Qualitative assessment of the cerebral sulci and cisterns on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the description of the cerebral sulci and cisterns from the imaging report. Assign 'unremarkable' for descriptors indicating a normal appearance (e.g., 'unremarkable', 'normal', 'within normal limits') and 'abnormal' for any description of pathology (e.g., 'effaced', 'widened', 'prominent', 'narrowed').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or does not explicitly describe the appearance of the sulci and cisterns.
definition.name: sulci_and_cisterns_appearance

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
